statement: Independent references for static-equivalent seismic that takes the masses the weight case takes (DEL-05-01, decided 2026-11-12). Invented inputs; no internal pressure; generated by exact rational arithmetic without product code.

conventions.axes: members along global +X; local y = global Y, local z = global Z
conventions.disp: nodal translations ux, uy, uz (m) and right-handed rotations rx, ry, rz (rad), global
conventions.reaction: force and moment the support exerts on the structure at its node, global
conventions.end: force and moment the node exerts on the member at end i and end j, global
conventions.load: generated member loads per length (N/m) and nodal wrenches (N, N m), global
conventions.resultant: sum of the generated loads; moments about the origin
conventions.shear_model: euler_bernoulli on both routes (EX: explicit selection)
conventions.pressure: none: no pressure region, no internal pressure anywhere

crosscheck.check: two methods agree on every response row
free-node balance of element end forces
equivalent nodal loads sum to the load resultant
global equilibrium, moments about the origin
row identity CANT PF seismic Z vs weight -Z
row identity CANT EX seismic Z vs weight -Z
row identity FIXED PF seismic Z vs weight -Z
row identity FIXED EX seismic Z vs weight -Z
binary64 inputs change no row sign
binary64 inputs change no discrete outcome
